metaDescription: Every EasyGo Spa therapist is trained, ID-verified and arrives in uniform. Choose your therapist from real profiles when you book.
title: Trained, Verified Therapists Who Come to You
lead: Every EasyGo Spa therapist meets the same standard before they take a single booking.

trained.title: Professionally Trained
trained.role: Skilled in every treatment they offer
trained.text: Our therapists are trained in the treatments they offer, from gentle Swedish and aromatherapy to deep tissue, Thai stretching and hot stone.
trained.alt: A therapist working slowly along a client’s shoulder blade as he rests on his hotel bed

verified.title: Identity Verified
verified.text: We check every therapist’s ID before they can take bookings. When you book, you see their real photo and name.
verified.alt: A therapist giving a gentle oil massage to a client lying on her own bed in a bright condo

uniform.title: Always in Uniform
uniform.role: Easy to recognize at your door
uniform.text: Your therapist arrives in the EasyGoSpa uniform, so you know exactly who is at your door.
uniform.alt: A therapist in the EasyGoSpa uniform walking down a condo hallway at night with towels and the EasyGoSpa bag

rated.title: Rated After Every Visit
rated.text: After each massage you can rate your therapist. Ratings show on their profile, so the next client can choose with confidence.
rated.alt: A therapist preparing towels for a client resting on her hotel bed at night

ctaText: When you book, you see each available therapist’s photo and profile and choose who comes to you.
